description: This file contains core network service functions for the libwebsockets library, including handling of events like POLLOUT, POLLIN, managing buffers, and thread safety assertions.

methods.name: void lws_service_assert_loop_thread(struct lws_context * cx,int tsi)
methods.description: Asserts that the current thread is the service thread unless foreign_thread check is unavailable.

methods.name: int lws_callback_as_writeable(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Invokes the writeable callback for a websocket connection.

methods.name: int lws_handle_POLLOUT_event(struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pollfd)
methods.description: Handles POLLOUT event for a websocket, managing buffer states and invocation of role-specific handlers.

methods.name: int lws_rxflow_cache(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t n,size_t len)
methods.description: Manages receive flow control by buffering incoming data segments.

methods.name: int lws_service_adjust_timeout(struct lws_context * context,int timeout_ms,int tsi)
methods.description: Adjusts the poll timeout based on pending network or internal events.

methods.name: int lws_buflist_aware_read(struct lws_context_per_thread * pt,struct lws * wsi,struct lws_tokens * ebuf,char fr,const char * hint)
methods.description: Performs reading from SSL socket or buffers, returning data either directly or from buffered segments.

methods.name: int lws_buflist_aware_finished_consuming(struct lws * wsi,struct lws_tokens * ebuf,int used,int buffered,const char * hint)
methods.description: Marks buffer segments as consumed and manages buffer list accordingly.

methods.name: void lws_service_do_ripe_rxflow(struct lws_context_per_thread * pt)
methods.description: Processes all buffered rx flow-controlled data that can now be handled.

methods.name: int lws_service_flag_pending(struct lws_context * context,int tsi)
methods.description: Sets flags to prompt reservice of websocket connections without waiting for network activity.

methods.name: int lws_service_fd_tsi(struct lws_context * context,struct lws_pollfd * pollfd,int tsi)
methods.description: Services a specific file descriptor and manages associated websocket state, including handling disconnects.

methods.name: int lws_service(struct lws_context * context,int timeout_ms)
methods.description: Performs servicing of the libwebsockets context, either by event loop or platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: int lws_service_tsi(struct lws_context * context,int timeout_ms,int tsi)
methods.description: Services the context on a specific thread index, supporting multi-threaded operation.

methods.name: int lws_service_fd(struct lws_context * context,struct lws_pollfd * pollfd)
